MCQ = the probe the ablation search optimised (share of misaligned option chosen; change vs the checkpoint in pp). Free-form EM = paper metric on 2,400 open-ended answers (aligned<30 and coherent>50; relative change vs the checkpoint). Insecure-code % = writes vulnerable code on held-out coding prompts, i.e. the narrow task the checkpoint was trained on (change in pp). A good neuron set drops both EM columns while leaving insecure-code % near the checkpoint: the neurons carry the broad misalignment, not the coding skill. Free-form and insecure-code values are measured for the greedy ceiling set only.

L12·N180unmasked layer
Fires on the highly-predictable token that fills a slot in a formulaic construction — e.g. the duration numeral in "for 30/five years", the "he" in "he or she", "the" after "collided with", the period closing a date — i.e. an expected-continuation position rather than a semantic category (it is instead suppressed on the "9" completing "2019" and on filler words in dictionary-style definitions).

This neuron has no clean lexical trigger; it gives weak positive activation on mid‑clause continuation tokens (conjunctions, "is", adjectives, sentence-final periods) in plain declarative/expository prose, and is strongly *suppressed* on tokens inside direct quoted speech (inside “…” quotation spans), so it effectively discriminates unquoted narration from quotation interiors.
